about: Terminal-Bench 2.0 (89 tasks), Harbor 0.21.0 package dataset terminal-bench/terminal-bench-2 at its pinned ref. Pins read read-only from tbench on 2026-10-16: each task package's cache directory ~/.cache/harbor/tasks/packages/terminal-bench/<name>/<content_hash> (one each), tree_sha256 = sha256 over "<file sha256>  <relative path>\n" of every file sorted by path, task.toml / instruction.md SHA-256, the [agent] / [verifier] / [environment] values; ref and checksum as Harbor recorded them in both August jobs (identical). dry_subset: the 16 tasks with a 900-s agent timeout and the largest August prompts (plan dry). dataset_order_observed: the trial start order of the 08-20 job (information).
